inc::Module::Package(3) User Contributed Perl Documentation inc::Module::Package(3)

SYNOPSIS

In you "Makefile.PL":

    use inc::Module::Package <options>;

DESCRIPTION

This is the Module::Package bootstrapping module. It works something like inc::Module::Install. This bootstrap module should only be loaded in an author environment.
